spans.s:
अदोमद अ-दोम-द or अ-दोम-ध, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. not occasioning inconvenience.

अदोह अ-दोह, अस्, m. (rt. दुह्), season when
milking is impracticable.

अ-दोग्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ (not milking), not
exacting; considerate.

आदो आ-दो, cl. 4. P. -द्यति, -दातुम्, to re-
duce to pieces or fragments; to tie, fetter. (In this
last sense, the rt. is better written दा; see 2. आ-दा.)
